title: Return Policy and Eligibility Windows
body:
Return Windows by Customer Tier

Standard customers: 60 days from delivery date for most products.

TechHome Plus members: 90 days from delivery date.

VIP customers: 90 days from delivery date.

Special Rules

Defective items: All customers can return defective products within 60 days of delivery, regardless of tier.

Refurbished products: Can ONLY be returned if defective. Returns for change of preference or buyer's remorse are not accepted on Certified Refurbished items.

Opened vs Unopened

Both opened and unopened items can be returned within the applicable window. However, opened items may be subject to a restocking fee (see our Restocking Fees article).
snippet: Standard customers: 60 days from delivery date for most products. TechHome Plus members: 90 days from delivery date...

title: Restocking Fees and Return Shipping Costs
body:
Restocking Fees

Standard customers: 15% restocking fee applies to opened items when returning for non-defect reasons (e.g., change of mind, ordered wrong item).

TechHome Plus members: Restocking fee is waived.

VIP customers: Restocking fee is waived.

Defective items: No restocking fee applies regardless of customer tier.

Return Shipping Costs

Small items: $8.99 return shipping fee (deducted from refund) for non-defect returns.

Defective items: Free return shipping label provided.

Plus and VIP members: Free return shipping on all returns.

Major Appliances

Removal fee: $50 fee applies for non-defect returns of installed major appliances to cover technician removal costs.
snippet: Standard customers: 15% restocking fee applies to opened items when returning for non-defect reasons (e.g., change of mind, ordered wrong item)...

title: Reward Points Program Rules and Restrictions
body:
Earning Points

TechHome Plus members: Earn 5% back in reward points on all eligible purchases.

Standard customers: Do not earn reward points.

Redemption Restrictions

Reward points CANNOT be redeemed on the following products:

  • Apple products (iPhone, iPad, MacBook, Apple Watch, AirPods, etc.)
  • Laptops priced over $1,500
  • Premium appliance brands (Sub-Zero, Wolf, Miele)
  • Products already on clearance (discounted more than 30% off regular price)

Discount Stacking

Reward points cannot be combined with percentage-based promotional discount codes. The system will automatically apply whichever discount provides the greater savings.

Reward points can be combined with TechHome Plus member exclusive pricing.

title: Installation Services and Workmanship Warranty
body:
Installation Service Pricing

Major appliances - Basic installation: $129 flat rate. Includes FREE delivery, unpacking, placement, connection to existing hookups, and packaging removal.

Major appliances - Advanced installation: $299 flat rate for installations requiring new electrical work, gas line installation, venting modifications, or other specialized work.

TV wall mounting: $99, includes free delivery.

Without installation service: Standard shipping cost of $55 applies for major appliances.

What's Included in Basic Installation

  • Free delivery to your home
  • Unpacking and placement in desired location
  • Connection to existing water, electrical, or gas hookups
  • Basic leveling and testing
  • Packaging removal

90-Day Workmanship Warranty

All installation services include a 90-day workmanship warranty covering:

  • Installation errors or improper connections
  • Damage caused during the installation process
  • Issues resulting from technician workmanship

Not covered: Product defects, normal wear and tear, or customer-caused damage after installation completion.

title: Warranty Coverage Periods by Product Category
body:
Manufacturer Warranties

Electronics (laptops, tablets, phones, cameras, etc.): 1 year from date of purchase.

Major appliances (refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers, ovens): 3 years from date of purchase.

Small appliances and other products: 1 year from date of purchase.

Extended Warranty Options

Available at checkout for most products:

  • 3-year extended warranty: Extends coverage for defects in materials and workmanship for an additional 3 years beyond manufacturer warranty.
  • 5-year extended warranty: Extends coverage for defects in materials and workmanship for an additional 5 years beyond manufacturer warranty.

Protection Plans

Available for select electronics and premium products:

  • Covers defects in materials and workmanship
  • Also covers accidental damage including drops, spills, and electrical surges
  • Available in 2-year or 3-year terms

Note: Items outside the return window (60 or 90 days) but within warranty coverage should be processed as warranty claims, not returns.
